title: Speech Recognition (ASR) — CTC, RNN-T, Attention
service: ASRKit: CTC decoding of acoustic-model frames, WER, a SQLite transcript store, streaming word events and word-lattice rescoring

parts.lesson_anchor: Build It, Steps 1 and 3: greedy CTC decode and WER; quiz Q9(b), Q8 and Q11
planted_bugs: greedy_decode updates prev only when it emits a letter, so a blank no longer separates repeats and hello decodes as helo; the failure shows up two calls away, in the test's WER check
wer divides by the number of hypothesis words; silence that decodes to an empty string raises ZeroDivisionError
edit_distance is a plain three-way recursion, exponential in the transcript length
memoizing that recursion still overflows Python's recursion limit on a 600-word meeting transcript
parts.timing_assert: 10x10-word WER under 0.03 s; every word is misheard, so a match shortcut does not help (the exponential recursion takes 0.5-1.4 s, the shortcut variant about 0.5 s, the table under 0.1 ms)
parts.overfix_guard: wer('a b', 'a b c d e') == 1.5, which rules out clipping WER at 1 or dividing by the longer transcript
parts.deviation: The greedy bug is planted as the quiz Q9(b) form (prev updated only on emit), which behaves exactly like dropping blanks before merging; that second form is a wrong fix in traps.json. A fourth layer was added: memoization passes the timing check but not a meeting-length transcript, so the fix ends at the lesson's bottom-up table.

parts.lesson_anchor: WER is reported per model against stored references; Pitfalls: normalize before scoring, which belongs to the scorer and not to storage
parts.exactness: references and hypotheses round-trip code point for code point in NFC, including m², the ﬁ ligature and Hangul given in NFD, across close and reopen
traps: ids not normalized on write or on lookup (NFD file names miss NFC rows)
hypotheses compared in NFC but stored as given
NFKC instead of NFC
WER-style lowercasing or accent folding in storage
INSERT OR REPLACE over an immutable model version
same-transcript check before NFC or case-insensitive
UNIQUE constraint raises IntegrityError, not ValueError
FOREIGN KEY not enforced by default
missing commit
CREATE TABLE without IF NOT EXISTS
utterance order, not hypothesis order or id order
clarifying_questions: normalize case and punctuation in the store

parts.lesson_anchor: Build It, Step 2 and Exercise 2: prefix beam search with P_blank / P_nonblank; quiz Q10 and Q12
traps: max (Viterbi) instead of summing alignments
one probability per prefix loses double letters
new letter extended from the blank-ending mass only
score that leaves out the blank-ending mass
the lesson's log(exp(a) + exp(b)) in the starter's log_add: -inf inputs and underflow on 1800 frames
zero-probability prefixes returned
pruning skipped, or done only at the end (a beam of 1 must return the empty prefix)
beam ranked by the larger of the two masses, or cut before equal prefixes are merged
scores rescaled every frame instead of log probabilities
parts.integration: soft frames go through the service; greedy and beam hypotheses are stored in Part 2's store and scored with Part 1's WER
parts.deviation: The starter ships log_add with the formula from the lesson's ctc_beam, so quiz Q12's underflow is a live trap rather than something the candidate has to think of.

parts.lesson_anchor: Build It, Step 5: streaming needs carryover state and timestamps; CTC is streamable with zero lookahead
parts.wire_format: Server-Sent Events: an event line, a data line with one JSON object, a blank line; decided by the test's parse_sse
traps: collapse state reset per chunk (a repeat split across chunks doubles a letter)
frame index counted per chunk
an empty chunk taken as the end of the stream
empty words from doubled or leading spaces
start_ms after the last space instead of at the first letter frame
end_ms moved only on new letters
prev not updated on space frames (go on decodes as go n)
timestamps in seconds
last word never flushed
single newline between messages
reading the whole stream first
clarifying_questions: last word without a trailing space
parts.deviation: Finality comes from the space token or the end of the stream, not from a prefix staying stable for N frames. Greedy CTC never rewrites what it has emitted, so a stability window would only add latency, and a decoder that does rewrite is Part 3's beam search; building Part 4 on it would make Part 4 fail whenever Part 3 is unfinished. The stability rule for beam search is a follow-up question instead.

parts.lesson_anchor: LM fusion (Key Terms; Use It: domain LM fusion): acoustic and LM scores combined over decoder hypotheses
traps: node ids not in topological order
parallel arcs between the same two nodes
the same transcript through four paths (a pause before the first word, two trailing silences), deduplicated at every node and not only at the end
silence arcs that add no score
lm_weight applied to the acoustic score
no path returning an empty list instead of raising
a cycle on a dead end that does not block the end node
enumerating 2**20 paths
parts.timing_assert: 20-stage ladder n-best under 0.05 s (path enumeration takes 0.7-1.05 s; the DP under 0.1 ms)
parts.deviation: Besides best path, n-best and cycle detection, the lattice carries acoustic and LM scores with an lm_weight, so the part exercises the lesson's LM fusion; a timing check rules out path enumeration.
